verdict.rationale: Workable's own marketing documents AI that screens and matches candidates. The Workable Agent sources, screens and qualifies every candidate against the spec and produces a shortlist, and AI recommendations are drawn from job ads. The second half of the story, vendor documentation of how the AI works and what safeguards apply to automated decisions, has no evidence at all. Missing for 10: documentation of how the matching/screening model works, documented safeguards for automated decisions (human review, bias auditing, explainability, candidate notice), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI helps screen and match candidates against the role — with the vendor documenting how it works and what safeguards apply to automated decisions

citations.quote: The Workable Agent runs the top of the funnel - sourcing, screening and qualifying every candidate against the spec - and hands your team an interview-ready shortlist.
Receive AI-generated recommendations of qualified candidates based on your job ad from a pool of 400 million profiles.
Search yourself or use AI to find qualified candidates that match your specific requirements.
